content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Makes motors, drives and motion controls for OEMs in industrial automation, aerospace and medical, closely matching AMETEK's electromechanical devices."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Builds asphalt plants and aggregate and mining machinery for road builders, a different business from AMETEK's instruments and devices."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Mainly makes industrial valves and pumps for plant operators, with only a minor aerospace component line overlapping AMETEK."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Is a distributor and outsourced supply chain provider of MRO supplies and test equipment, not a manufacturer of instruments and devices."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Is a distributor of electronic components and fasteners buying from manufacturers, not designing and building instruments or devices."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Makes welding and cutting consumables and equipment for fabricators and contractors, unrelated to AMETEK's instruments and electromechanical products."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Makes power system test equipment, metering and aerospace and defense electronics sold to utilities and defense primes, overlapping AMETEK's test and instrument businesses."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Makes pumps, valves and mechanical seals for process plants, a fluid handling business rather than instruments and electromechanical devices."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Core business is pumps, valves and friction products; its connector and sensor line is a minor overlap with AMETEK."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Makes switchgear and substations for power distribution, not the instruments, motors and sensors AMETEK sells."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Formulates specialty chemical fluids, lubricants and coatings, a chemical business unrelated to AMETEK."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Core business is HVAC equipment and UV disinfection for buildings and utilities, with only a small detection instrument line overlapping AMETEK."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Makes business jets, helicopters and armored vehicles, a different aircraft and vehicle business from AMETEK's instruments and devices."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Makes locks, hinges and metal castings for equipment makers, mechanical hardware rather than instruments or electronic devices."},{"label":"C15","good":false,"reason":"Core business is coding and marking printers for food and pharma makers; its water instruments are a smaller, different line."},{"label":"C16","good":false,"reason":"Makes network test instruments sold mainly to telecom carriers, a different customer base from AMETEK's industrial and defense buyers."}]}
